episode_title: Email Marketing for Recruiters: Why Your Database Beats Any Algorithm

real_qa.q: What is the average email open rate for staffing companies compared to the general population benchmark?
real_qa.r: Staffing companies on average have an open rate of around 31%, which is over 46% higher than the average general benchmark of around 21%. This is because recruitment emails engage more than most, as people are interested in jobs and building their teams.
real_qa.requete: staffing companies email open rate benchmark

real_qa.q: How do candidates and clients behave differently when opening recruitment emails?
real_qa.r: Candidates open emails more frequently out of curiosity but often do nothing else. Clients and hiring managers open less often but click through at more than three times the rate of candidates, around 13% for clients against under 4% for candidates. This shows that a hiring manager who opens and clicks is a highly qualified, intentional reader.
real_qa.requete: recruitment email click-through rate candidates vs clients

real_qa.q: What is the return on investment for email marketing compared to other channels?
real_qa.r: Email is consistently reported as the highest ROI marketing channel across every industry, with figures most sources share somewhere between £36 to £42 back for every pound spent. Email returns more than paid search, more than social ads, and more than display by a wide margin.
real_qa.requete: email marketing ROI return pounds spent

real_qa.q: How many people check email daily and what percentage of the global population uses email?
real_qa.r: There are around four and a half billion email users in the world, roughly half of the planet. 93% of people check email every day, with most checking it several times a day, and nearly two thirds check it mainly on their phone.
real_qa.requete: percentage people check email daily global users

real_qa.q: What are the three main jobs that email marketing performs better than any other channel in recruitment?
real_qa.r: Email does three jobs better than anything else: reigniting people you've gone quiet with or silent with from your past client and candidate database; nurturing prospects through the buying cycle by staying in front of people who aren't ready yet but eventually will be; and building authority and thought leadership through regular newsletters, market updates, and salary insights to stop being a supplier and start being an advisor.
real_qa.requete: three jobs email marketing recruitment better than other channels
